card.what: Twin-eye ribbed vinyl fender (6.5 x 22 in) and 3/8 in three-strand nylon dock lines: a 12 in spliced eye round the boat's cleat, a cleat hitch on the dock's 10 in cleat
card.boats: every keelboat's in-slip dress (build_berthed.py: J/22, Catalina 22 in slips; Catalina 30 alongside); kit parts for touches and later live lines
card.distance: from the finger and the cockpit when she is tied up in her slip at the start of a session; the marina's neighbours from the water
card.before: berthed dress: 10-sided tube fenders, 5-sided 12 mm lines ending at fixed points 0.5 m up; kit Fender 150 x 500 mm with ring ribs

references.note: Polyform G-4 class twin-eye fender 6.5 x 22 in, for 20-30 ft boats
3/8 in for boats to about 27 ft (also West Marine, betterboat dock line charts)
3/8 in x 15 ft three-strand nylon, 12 in eye

features.text: Lengthwise ribs on the fender body, fading on the shoulders
Moulded eye lug with a rope hole at each fender end
Inflation valve on the top shoulder
Three-strand right-hand lay visible on every line
Spliced eye: the tucked strands fatten the standing part and taper off
Cleat hitch: turn round the base, figure eight over the top, locking hitch, tail on the dock
The eye goes round the boat cleat's base under both horns

budget.note: kit parts each under 20k; the berthed dress is one Nanite mesh per variant
